race.description: Pryde's Easifeed Energy Pak Trotters Up To Nr55 Mbl
race.comment: KICKING HORSE (2) drew wider last start and was solid enough when midfield. Good effort to come from a 10m handicap for second at this circuit and distance prior. Should get his chance from the good draw. SERENA LOVE (8) put the writing on the wall with back-to-back placings before scoring by 3.5 metres at this circuit and distance last week. If things go her way from the back line she is capable of getting the job done again. LAYDOWNLUNA (7) draws wide but must be considered after she added to her consistent form with a third from a 20m handicap last week. SECOND TO NUN (1) gets the ace draw and overcame a back row barrier to score the last time she started behind a mobile.
